name: Hushdrive Mk I
description: A narrow drive cut from an old frame's spine. It makes almost no light.

name: Hushdrive Mk II
description: Mk II re-forges the throat with a seam that shows.

name: Hushdrive Mk III
description: Mk III is a Court rebuild, black to the nozzle.

name: Murkwake Mk I
description: A twin-throat drive that runs cold and spits a faint violet trace.

name: Murkwake Mk II
description: The throats are re-cast from a second salvaged frame.

name: Murkwake Mk III
description: A tight, quiet burn that sensors find hard to follow.

name: Dirgeburn Mk I
description: A mid-weight drive grafted from elder gantry stock. It sounds like a held breath.

name: Dirgeburn Mk II
description: Its mismatched halves have been trued, mostly.

name: Dirgeburn Mk III
description: Court wrights swear the third pattern is the old one, restored.

name: Tombfire Mk I
description: A long drive pulled from a ruin's cargo spine and made to burn again.

name: Tombfire Mk II
description: The seams are re-welded in a darker alloy.

name: Tombfire Mk III
description: It burns nearly invisible and costs accordingly.

name: Barrowfall Mk I
description: A vast salvaged drive, black with age, that wakes slowly and then does not stop.

name: Barrowfall Mk II
description: The cooling ribs are replaced one at a time, as parts turn up.

name: Barrowfall Mk III
description: A Court barge-drive, built to move a hold quietly and for a long time.

name: Coldseed cell Mk I
description: A palm-sized cell that burns old fuel from a ruin's stores and gives six pips. It gives off no glare.

name: Coldseed cell Mk II
description: Mk II is re-lit with cleaner stock.

name: Coldseed cell Mk III
description: Mk III runs hot inside and shows nothing outside.

name: Gravelamp plant Mk I
description: A lamp-shaped plant salvaged from a flooded gantry. It glows a dim, cold violet.

name: Gravelamp plant Mk II
description: The glass is replaced and the filament re-wound.

name: Gravelamp plant Mk III
description: A steady plant that likes the dark.

name: Ossuary plant Mk I
description: A medium plant built into an elder ossuary casing. Heavy for its output, and quiet.

name: Ossuary plant Mk II
description: The casing is re-ribbed with newer plate.

name: Ossuary plant Mk III
description: Court wrights keep this pattern for hulls that expect a long night.

name: Sepulchre core Mk I
description: A broad core lifted from a sepulchre's reactor ring. It needs no star to run.

name: Sepulchre core Mk II
description: A second salvaged core is welded alongside the first.

name: Sepulchre core Mk III
description: Black, ribbed and warm to the touch.

name: Deepvault heart Mk I
description: The great plant of the barges, taken from a dead court's deep vault.

name: Deepvault heart Mk II
description: Its vault plates are re-forged to a tighter fit.

name: Deepvault heart Mk III
description: It has run for longer than the Courts have kept records.

name: Shroudglass Mk I
description: A thin dark film that bends light away. It holds little and says nothing.

name: Shroudglass Mk II
description: The film is doubled at the edges.

name: Shroudglass Mk III
description: A third pass of ash glaze. It still breaks early.

name: Pallveil Mk I
description: A twin-layer veil of smoked glass. Rebuilds in its own time.

name: Pallveil Mk II
description: A tighter weave, a little less see-through.

name: Pallveil Mk III
description: Cold to the touch and slow to forgive.

name: Duskward Mk I
description: A falling curtain of dusk, thrown from an elder emitter ring.

name: Duskward Mk II
description: Better ring spacing and a shorter pause.

name: Duskward Mk III
description: The ring carries a Court mark nobody will explain.

name: Umbral screen Mk I
description: A great dim screen of salvaged emitters. It spreads the load and shows no light.

name: Umbral screen Mk II
description: Several emitters are swapped for better matched ones.

name: Umbral screen Mk III
description: A broad screen that sensors have trouble finding.

name: Nightfast wall Mk I
description: A wall of shadow-glass drawn across the whole hull. Slow to build, hard to see.

name: Nightfast wall Mk II
description: Retuned to refill a little sooner.

name: Nightfast wall Mk III
description: The largest veil the Courts raise, and the thinnest for its size.

name: Hush array Mk I
description: A small dark lens that listens for what other ships hope to hide.

name: Hush array Mk II
description: A sharper lens ground from a cracked original.

name: Hush array Mk III
description: Hand-ground and lightless, with a very long ear.

name: Mourning lens Mk I
description: A paired-lens suite that hears a drive through a rock.

name: Mourning lens Mk II
description: The apertures are widened and re-sealed.

name: Mourning lens Mk III
description: Court sensor-wrights call this one the better witness.

name: Deepwatch comb Mk I
description: A fan of black ribs salvaged from an elder watch tower. It sees a long way and is seen by little.

name: Deepwatch comb Mk II
description: The ribs are re-seated on a cooler mount.

name: Deepwatch comb Mk III
description: A tower's eye on a ship's hull, and not entirely tame.

name: Hush needle S1 Mk I
description: A fine violet needle that flies true and makes no sound.

name: Hush needle S1 Mk II
description: Mk II is re-cut from a better salvaged lens.

name: Hush needle S1 Mk III
description: Mk III is a Court rebuild with a longer reach.

name: Hush needle S2 Mk I
description: A longer needle, with the same dreadful patience.

name: Hush needle S2 Mk II
description: Mk II is re-cut from a better salvaged lens.

name: Hush needle S2 Mk III
description: Mk III is a Court rebuild with a longer reach.

name: Hush needle S3 Mk I
description: A spindle of cold light that finds a gap in the shield and stays there.

name: Hush needle S3 Mk II
description: Mk II is re-cut from a better salvaged lens.

name: Hush needle S3 Mk III
description: Mk III is a Court rebuild with a longer reach.

name: Dirge caster S1 Mk I
description: A slow pale bolt that arrives late and hits hard. It leaves the target cold.

name: Dirge caster S1 Mk II
description: Mk II is re-cut from a better salvaged lens.

name: Dirge caster S1 Mk III
description: Mk III is a Court rebuild with a longer reach.

name: Dirge caster S2 Mk I
description: A heavier bolt, drawn out like a long note.

name: Dirge caster S2 Mk II
description: Mk II is re-cut from a better salvaged lens.

name: Dirge caster S2 Mk III
description: Mk III is a Court rebuild with a longer reach.

name: Dirge caster S3 Mk I
description: A big pale-violet bolt that hangs in the dark before it lands.

name: Dirge caster S3 Mk II
description: Mk II is re-cut from a better salvaged lens.

name: Dirge caster S3 Mk III
description: Mk III is a Court rebuild with a longer reach.

name: Salvage cradle
description: Black slatted racks, light and unmarked.

name: Crypt rack
description: A hold of re-skinned elder plate.

name: Ossuary hold
description: A lightless bay for goods nobody asks about.

name: Long vault
description: A narrow vault along the keel, with a rail for sealed crates.

name: Grand ossuary
description: A great ribbed hold, packed with the care of long habit.

name: Shadow veil Mk I
description: A cold shroud that swallows the ship's heat and glow. It does well in the dark and badly near a bright star.

name: Shadow veil Mk II
description: A deeper shroud. It hides more, and suffers more when the light is full.

name: Ruin scanner Mk I
description: A tuned probe that reads old structure through rubble and silence. Useful for finding what is worth taking.

name: Salvage claw Mk I
description: Hooked arms and a cutting beam for stripping wrecks. Court crews prefer it to asking.

name: Scar forge Mk I
description: A tiny forge that re-welds damage with whatever metal is to hand. The repairs show.

name: The Ninth Lamp
description: A watch-tower lens taken whole from the ruin it was named for. It sees further than anything the Courts will sell, and it is not clear who it is looking for.

name: Hollow Gate drive
description: A drive pulled out of a gate-keeper's frame. It burns without flame and makes the cabin very quiet.

name: Last Word
description: A long elder lance with no maker's mark. The bolt is slow, pale and final.
